name: Ice Brute

source.note: A made-up stat block for the engine tests (host-free); built from the 2025 Monster Manual frost giant.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.summary: Two Frozen Fists, or Hurled Ice when no one is in reach.
actions.text: The Ice Brute makes two Frozen Fist attacks, or tears off slabs of ice and hurls them when no one is within its reach.

actions.name: Frozen Fist
actions.summary: A fist of fused hands and ice, reach 10 ft.
actions.text: Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) Bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) Cold damage.

actions.name: Hurled Ice
actions.summary: Tears a slab of ice from itself and hurls it, 60/240 ft.
actions.text: Range 60/240 ft. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) Bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) Cold damage.

actions.name: Rime Embrace
actions.summary: Recharge 5-6: everything within 20 ft makes a DC 16 Con save: 4d8 Cold and Restrained (frozen to the ground) until the end of its next turn, half damage on a success.
actions.text: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, each creature within 20 feet of the Ice Brute. Failure: 18 (4d8) Cold damage, and the target has the Restrained condition until the end of the Ice Brute's next turn. Success: Half damage only.

summary: A made-up ice giant for the engine tests: fists with reach, hurled ice, and a recharging 20 ft embrace.
